content: {"episode_id":"ep-05070","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"CO-97","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93271 was performed for a patient with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness in the setting of known unspecified atrial fibrillation (I48.91).
